content_md:
I’m hoping that, because it brings together writing and AI seamlessly, blygging turns into an activity where you discover what AI unlocks.

Thicketing is interesting, in that it turns the activity of researching into Place arranging. You can take very complex ideas, even things that would have been theses in themselves, and use them as a way to dig a new portal.

But thicketing still pretty unnatural to do—at least for me it is. Soon we shall all be [Nakatomi Drifting](https://aneeshsathe.com/nakatomi-drift/).
